environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the IoT firmware handler. Container runs as root (UID 0). The /var/iot/firmware_staging directory is a hostPath volume mount to the node's filesystem. No filesystem restrictions beyond standard ext4. The service is exposed via a NodePort with no ingress controller filtering. pgBouncer runs in transaction pooling mode on port 6432 with prepared statement support disabled (as reflected in code's statement_cache_size=0).
